local V = require 'CSV/Core'
local M = {}
M.metrics={requested=0,queued=0,active=0,blocked=0,failed=0}
M.history={}
local playing=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
local recent = setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})

local function hasShoutItem(player)
    local function special(item) return item and item:getShoutType() ~= nil end
    if special(player:getPrimaryHandItem()) or special(player:getSecondaryHandItem()) then return true end
    local worn = player:getWornItems()
    if worn then
        for i=0,worn:size()-1 do if special(worn:get(i):getItem()) then return true end end
    end
    return false
end

function M.call(player)
    if player and player.isDead and player:isDead() then return true end
    if not require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(player) then return false end
    M.metrics.requested=M.metrics.requested+1
    if not require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').calloutAllowed(player) then M.metrics.blocked=M.metrics.blocked+1;return true end
    local sneaking = player:isSneaking()
    if not sneaking and hasShoutItem(player) then return false end
    if not player:isCanShout() then return true end
    local bank = V.bank(V.voice(player))
    local pool = bank.native.replacements[sneaking and 'WhisperHey' or 'ShoutHey']
    local previous = recent[player]
    if previous and player:getEmitter():isPlaying(player:getDescriptor():getVoicePrefix()..'CSV'..previous) then M.metrics.blocked=M.metrics.blocked+1;return true end
    local candidates = {}
    for _,id in ipairs(pool) do if id ~= previous then candidates[#candidates+1]=id end end
    if #candidates==0 then candidates=pool end
    if #candidates==0 then return false end
    local id = candidates[ZombRand(#candidates)+1]
    local item = player:getPrimaryHandItem()
    local mega = item and item:hasTag(ItemTag.MEGAPHONE)
    local radius = sneaking and (mega and 18 or 6) or (mega and 90 or 30)
    local handle=player:transmitPlayerVoiceSound('CSV'..id)
    if not handle or handle==0 then M.metrics.failed=M.metrics.failed+1;return true end
    M.stopSpeech(player)
    recent[player] = id
    local entry={voice=V.voice(player),id=id,text=bank.lines[id],radius=radius,sneaking=sneaking,megaphone=mega==true,at=getTimestampMs(),handle=handle,state='queued'}
    M.history[#M.history+1]=entry
    if #M.history>32 then table.remove(M.history,1)end
    playing[player]=entry;M.metrics.queued=M.metrics.queued+1
    if V.client and V.client.captionsEnabled and V.client.captionsEnabled() then player:SayShout(bank.lines[id]) end
    addSound(player,player:getX(),player:getY(),player:getZ(),radius,radius)
    player:playEmote('shout')
    return true
end

function M.stopSpeech(player)
    require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').claimCallout(player)
end

function M.busy(player)
    if not player then return false end
    M.observe(player)
    if playing[player] then return true end
    if not require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(player) then return false end
    local emitter=player:getEmitter();local prefix=player:getDescriptor():getVoicePrefix()
    if not emitter or not prefix then return false end
    -- Includes engine-owned calls, special shout items and remote characters.
    for _,suffix in ipairs({'ShoutHey','ShoutMegaphoneHey','WhisperHey','WhisperPsst','WhisperMegaphoneHey','WhisperMegaphonePsst'})do
        if emitter:isPlaying(prefix..suffix) then return true end
    end
    local native=V.bank(V.voice(player)).native
    for _,source in ipairs({'ShoutHey','WhisperHey'})do
        for _,id in ipairs(native.replacements[source] or {})do
            if emitter:isPlaying(prefix..'CSV'..id) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function M.interrupt(player)
    local entry=playing[player]
    if not entry then return end
    playing[player]=nil
    entry.state='interrupted_by_injury'
    local emitter=player:getEmitter()
    if emitter and emitter.stopSoundLocal then emitter:stopSoundLocal(entry.handle) end
end

function M.observe(player)
    local entry=playing[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if player.isDead and player:isDead() then M.interrupt(player);entry.state='actor_dead';return end
    if require('CSV/NativeVoice').painActive(player) then M.interrupt(player);return end
    local emitter=player:getEmitter()
    if not emitter then entry.state='emitter_unavailable';playing[player]=nil;return end
    local active=emitter:isPlaying(entry.handle)
    local pending=emitter.hasSoundsToStart and emitter:hasSoundsToStart()
    if active and not pending and not entry.started then
        entry.started=getTimestampMs();entry.state='engine_active';M.metrics.active=M.metrics.active+1
    elseif not active and getTimestampMs()-entry.at>=250 then
        entry.state=entry.started and 'engine_finished' or 'ended_before_start';playing[player]=nil
    end
end

function M.export(writer)
    local m=M.metrics
    writer:write('VOICE_CALLOUT requested='..m.requested..' queued='..m.queued..' engineActive='..m.active..' blocked='..m.blocked..' failed='..m.failed..'\n')
    for _,entry in ipairs(M.history)do
        -- Kahlua's %q truncates non-ASCII characters, e.g. Turkish dotless i.
        local caption='"'..entry.text:gsub('\\','\\\\'):gsub('"','\\"'):gsub('\r','\\r'):gsub('\n','\\n')..'"'
        writer:write('VOICE_CALL voice='..tostring(entry.voice)..' line='..entry.id..' caption='..caption..' sneaking='..tostring(entry.sneaking)..' megaphone='..tostring(entry.megaphone)..' radius='..entry.radius..' at='..entry.at..' state='..entry.state..'\n')
    end
end

function M.install(menu)
    if menu.csvCalloutKeyInstalled then return end
    menu.csvCalloutKeyInstalled = true
    local emote=menu.emote
    menu.emote=function(self,name,...)
        if name=='shout' and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(self.character) and M.call(self.character) then
            self.character:setJoypadIgnoreAimUntilCentered(true);return
        end
        return emote(self,name,...)
    end
    local pressed, released = menu.onKeyPressed, menu.onKeyReleased
    local pending
    menu.onKeyPressed = function(key)
        if getCore():isKey(KeybindId.SHOUT,key) then
            pending=nil
            if menu.checkKey(key) and getCore():getGameMode()~='Tutorial' then
                local p=getSpecificPlayer(0)
                if require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() then
                    pending={player=p,at=getTimestampMs(),closedRadial=getCore():getOptionRadialMenuKeyToggle() and getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible()}
                end
            end
        end
        return pressed(key)
    end
    menu.onKeyReleased = function(key)
        if not getCore():isKey(KeybindId.SHOUT,key) then return released(key) end
        local press=pending
        pending=nil
        local p=getSpecificPlayer(0)
        if press and p==press.player and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() then
            if menu.checkKey(key) and not press.closedRadial and not getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible() and getTimestampMs()-press.at<450 then
                if M.call(p) then return end
            end
        elseif not press and p and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() and getCore():getGameMode()~='Tutorial' and not getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible() then
            return
        end
        return released(key)
    end
end
return M

-- Traumatic injury evidence is independent of need recovery and speech cooldowns.
local I={players=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),sequence=0,context=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
local call=require('CSV/Actors').call
local V=require 'CSV/Core'
local fields={bite='getBiteTime',scratch='getScratchTime',cut='getCutTime',deep='getDeepWoundTime',burn='getBurnTime',fracture='getFractureTime'}
local function finite(n)return type(n)=='number' and n==n and n~=math.huge and n~=-math.huge end
local function eligible(p)
 return p and call(p,'isLocalPlayer')==true and call(p,'isDead')==false and V.config.enabled and V.languageSupported() and V.extended(V.voice(p))
end
function I.snapshot(p)
 local body=call(p,'getBodyDamage');local parts=call(body,'getBodyParts');local count=call(parts,'size')
 if type(count)~='number' then return nil end
 local out={}
 for index=0,count-1 do
  local part=call(parts,'get',index);local row={health=call(part,'getHealth'),bleeding=call(part,'getBleedingTime'),stitched=call(part,'stitched')}
  for key,method in pairs(fields)do row[key]=call(part,method) end
  out[index]=row
 end
 return out
end
local function state(p)
 local s=I.players[p];if not s then s={budget=0};I.players[p]=s end;return s
end
local function loss(before,after)
 return finite(before) and finite(after) and after<before
end
function I.emit(p,kind,source,part)
 if not eligible(p) then return false end
 local s=state(p);local now=V.now()
 -- Several native notifications in one engine update describe one injury episode.
 if s.emittedAt==now then return false end
 if s.nativeWait then require('CSV/Trace').step(s.nativeWait.trace,'cancelled','newer_injury');s.nativeWait=nil end
 s.emittedAt=now;I.sequence=I.sequence+1
 require('CSV/TraitReactions').injury(p,kind,part)
 require('CSV/State').record(p,'physicalInjury');require('CSV/State').record(p,'acute')
 local trace=require('CSV/Trace')
 local t=trace.begin(p,'AcutePain',source,{acute=true})
 trace.step(t,'injury_confirmed',kind,{part=part,event=I.sequence})
 local native=require 'CSV/NativeVoice'
 if native.supported(V.voice(p)) and native.ready(p) then
  require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe(V.voice(p)..'_injury_detected_'..kind,{acute=true})
  trace.step(t,'delegated','await_native_'..V.voice(p)..'_pain')
  if native.painActive(p) then trace.step(t,'native_active','injury_audio_observed')
  else s.nativeWait={deadline=now+200,trace=t,sequence=I.sequence} end
  return true
 end
 return I.fallback(p,t,I.sequence)
end
function I.fallback(p,t,sequence)
 local trace=require 'CSV/Trace'
 trace.step(t,'fallback','native_pain_unavailable')
 require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').injury(p)
 local previous=I.context[p];I.context[p]=sequence
 local ok,err=pcall(trace.call,t,p,require('ConditionalSpeech_Core').generateSpeechFrom,p,'AcutePain',4,4,false,true)
 I.context[p]=previous
 if not ok then error(err)end
 return true
end
function I.observe(p,parts,now)
 if not eligible(p) then I.players[p]=nil;return end
 local s=state(p);now=now or V.now()
 if not parts then s.before=nil;s.pending=nil;s.lastAt=nil;return end
 local previous=s.before;local continuous=previous and s.lastAt and now-s.lastAt<=2000
 local kind,where
 if continuous then
  for index,row in pairs(parts)do
   local old=previous[index]
   if old then for name in pairs(fields)do
    local a,b=old[name],row[name]
    if finite(a) and finite(b) and b>0 and not (old.stitched==true and row.stitched==false and (name=='scratch' or name=='deep')) then
     if b>a+0.00001 and (name~='deep' or a==0) then kind=name;where=index;break end
     -- Native bite healing is at most 0.0001 * multiplier per update.
     -- Twice that accumulated allowance plus float tolerance is conservative.
     if (name=='bite' or name=='scratch' or name=='cut') and s.clockKnown and a-b>(s.budget-(s.lastBudget or s.budget))*(name=='bite' and 0.0002 or 0.001)+0.001 and loss(old.health,row.health) then kind='bite';where=index;break end
    end
   end end
   if kind then break end
  end
 end
 if s.pending then
  if now-s.pending.at<=1000 then
   for index,row in pairs(parts)do local old=s.pending.before[index]
    local chronic=not old or not finite(old.bleeding) or old.bleeding>0
    if old then for name in pairs(fields)do if not finite(old[name]) or old[name]>0 then chronic=true end end end
    if old and not chronic and loss(old.health,row.health) then kind=kind or 'weapon';where=where or index;break end
   end
  else require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('injury_weapon_unconfirmed',{});s.pending=nil end
 end
 s.before=parts;s.lastAt=now;s.lastBudget=s.budget;s.clockKnown=nil
 if kind then
  s.pending=nil
  -- Direct post-damage callbacks already represented this snapshot's changes.
  if not s.directSinceSample then I.emit(p,kind,'body_injury_transition',where) end
 end
 s.directSinceSample=nil
end
function I.signal(p,kind,amount)
 if not eligible(p) or not finite(amount) or amount<=0 then return end
 local s=state(p)
 if kind=='WEAPONHIT' then
  -- Native callback is BEFORE hit validation/damage, including avoided hits.
  local before=I.snapshot(p)
  if before and not s.pending then s.pending={at=V.now(),before=before};require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('injury_weapon_signal',{}) end
 elseif kind=='FALLDOWN' or kind=='CARHITDAMAGE' or kind=='CARCRASHDAMAGE' or kind=='FIRE' then
  if kind=='FIRE' and s.fireActive then return end
  if kind=='FIRE' then s.fireActive=true end
  s.directSinceSample=true
  I.emit(p,kind,'native_damage_applied')
 elseif s.pending then
  -- A simultaneous physiological/unknown damage source makes bare health loss ambiguous.
  s.pending=nil
 end
 -- Hunger, poison, infection, bleeding and unknown names are not trauma events.
end
function I.tick()
 local now=V.now();local multiplier=call(getGameTime and getGameTime(),'getMultiplier')
 for index=0,getNumActivePlayers()-1 do
  local p=getSpecificPlayer(index)
  if eligible(p) then
   local s=state(p)
   local wait=s.nativeWait
   if wait then
    local native=require 'CSV/NativeVoice'
    if native.painActive(p) then
     s.nativeWait=nil;require('CSV/Trace').step(wait.trace,'native_active','injury_audio_observed')
    elseif not native.ready(p) or now>=wait.deadline then
     s.nativeWait=nil;I.fallback(p,wait.trace,wait.sequence)
    end
   end
   local known=finite(multiplier) and multiplier>=0
   s.clockKnown=s.clockKnown~=false and known
   if known then s.budget=s.budget+multiplier end
   if call(p,'isOnFire')==false then s.fireActive=false end
   if not s.nextRead or now>=s.nextRead then
    s.nextRead=now+250;I.observe(p,I.snapshot(p),now)
   end
  elseif p then I.players[p]=nil end
 end
end
return I

local O={watch={},pending={},players=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),nextTick=0,hooks={}}
local V=require 'CSV/Core'
local S=require 'CSV/State'
local R=require 'CSV/OutcomeRules'
local function call(o,k,...)
 local ok,fn=pcall(function()return o and o[k]end)
 if ok and fn then local good,v=pcall(fn,o,...);if good then return v end end
end
O.call=call
local function eligible(p)
 return p and call(p,'isLocalPlayer')==true and call(p,'isDead')==false and V.config.enabled and V.extended(V.voice(p)) and require('CSV/Core').languageSupported()
end
function O.snapshot(kind,obj,p)
 if kind=='car_door' then
  local door=call(obj,'getDoor')
  return {open=call(door,'isOpen'),locked=call(door,'isLocked'),broken=call(door,'isLockBroken')}
 end
 if kind=='window' then return {open=call(obj,'IsOpen'),locked=call(obj,'isLocked')==true or call(obj,'isPermaLocked')==true,blocked=call(obj,'isBarricaded')==true,destroyed=call(obj,'isDestroyed')} end
 if kind=='trait' then return require('CSV/TraitReactions').snapshot(p) end
 if kind=='darkness' then return require('CSV/Darkness').snapshot(p) end
 if kind=='vehicle_combat' then return {occupied=call(p,'getVehicle')==obj} end
 if kind:match('^vehicle_') then return require('CSV/Vehicles').snapshot(obj,p) end
 if kind=='swing' or kind=='gun' then return {condition=call(obj,'getCondition'),jammed=call(obj,'isJammed'),rounds=call(obj,'getCurrentAmmoCount'),perShot=call(obj,'getAmmoPerShoot'),hasChamber=call(obj,'haveChamber'),chamber=call(obj,'isRoundChambered'),spent=call(obj,'isSpentRoundChambered')}
 elseif kind=='bandage' then return {bandaged=call(obj,'bandaged')}
 elseif kind=='disinfect' then return {alcohol=call(obj,'getAlcoholLevel')}
 elseif kind=='door' then
  local blocked=call(obj,'isObstructed');local barricaded=call(obj,'isBarricaded')
  return {open=call(obj,'IsOpen'),locked=call(obj,'isLocked')==true or call(obj,'isLockedByKey')==true,blocked=blocked==true or barricaded==true}
 else return {running=call(obj,'isEngineRunning'),starting=call(obj,'isStarting'),battery=call(obj,'getBatteryCharge'),fuel=call(obj,'getRemainingFuelPercentage')} end
end
function O.begin(kind,p,obj)
 if not eligible(p) or not obj then return end
 local e={kind=kind,player=p,obj=obj,before=O.snapshot(kind,obj,p),at=V.now()}
 if kind=='car_door' then
  local car=call(obj,'getVehicle');local x,y=call(car,'getX'),call(car,'getY')
  if type(x)=='number' and type(y)=='number' then e.offsetX=call(p,'getX')-x;e.offsetY=call(p,'getY')-y end
 end
 return e
end
function O.finish(e)
 if not e or e.cancelled or e.finished then return end
 if e.kind=='start' then e.sawStarting=O.snapshot('start',e.obj,e.player).starting==true end
 e.completed=true;e.finished=V.now();e.deadline=e.finished+(e.kind=='start' and 10000 or 5000);O.watch[#O.watch+1]=e
end
function O.queue(e,group)
 if e.consumed or e.queued then return false end
 local p=e.player;local s=O.players[p] or {last={}};O.players[p]=s
 local now=V.now();local gap=group=='FuelLow' and 300000 or group=='WeaponBroken' and 10000 or 45000
 if not require('CSV/VehicleRules').groups[group] and s.last[group] and now-s.last[group]<gap then return false end
 for i=#O.pending,1,-1 do
  local q=O.pending[i]
  if q.player==p and q.group==group then
   if now>q.expires or not O.valid(q) then table.remove(O.pending,i) else return false end
  end
 end
 e.group=group;e.queued=now;e.expires=now+(group=='WeaponBroken' and 5000 or R.urgent(group) and 8000 or 20000);O.pending[#O.pending+1]=e
 require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('outcome_queued',{outcomeKind=e.kind,outcomeGroup=group,outcomeNativeSound=e.nativeSound})
 return true
end
function O.valid(e)
 if e.consumed or e.cancelled then return false end
 local p=e.player;if not eligible(p) then return false end
 if e.kind:match('^vehicle_') then return require('CSV/Vehicles').valid(e) end
 if e.kind=='gun' then return call(p,'getPrimaryHandItem')==e.obj end
 if e.kind=='start' or e.kind=='fuel' then return call(p,'getVehicle')==e.obj and call(e.obj,'isDriver',p)==true end
 if e.kind=='car_door' then
  local car=call(e.obj,'getVehicle');local x,y=call(car,'getX'),call(car,'getY')
  if type(x)~='number' or type(y)~='number' then return false end
  -- Keep the attempted door's position relative to the vehicle, including long vans.
  local d=call(p,'DistTo',x+(e.offsetX or 0),y+(e.offsetY or 0))
  return type(d)=='number' and d<=3
 end
 if e.kind=='door' or e.kind=='window' then local d=call(p,'DistTo',call(e.obj,'getX'),call(e.obj,'getY'));return type(d)=='number' and d<=3 end
 return true
end
function O.update()
 local now=V.now()
 for i=#O.watch,1,-1 do
  local e=O.watch[i]
  if not O.valid(e) or e.cancelled or now>e.deadline then table.remove(O.watch,i)
  elseif now-e.finished>=250 then
   e.after=O.snapshot(e.kind,e.obj,e.player)
   if e.kind=='start' then
    e.sawStarting=e.sawStarting or e.after.starting==true
    -- A real crank must end, or a verified dead battery must prevent it.
    e.settled=e.sawStarting and e.after.starting==false or e.after.battery==0 and now-e.finished>=2000
   end
   local group=R.classify(e)
   if group then
    if e.kind=='start' then require('CSV/Vehicles').failed(e) end
    O.queue(e,group);table.remove(O.watch,i)
   elseif e.kind=='door' or (e.kind=='window' or e.kind=='car_door') and e.after.open==true or e.kind=='start' and e.after.running==true then table.remove(O.watch,i) end
  end
 end
 require('CSV/Sort').sort(O.pending,function(a,b)return require('CSV/Priority').before(a,b,function(e)return require('CSV/Priority').rank(R.urgent(e.group))end,function(e)return e.queued end)end)
 for i=#O.pending,1,-1 do
  local e=O.pending[i];local p=e.player;local s=O.players[p]
  e.after=O.snapshot(e.kind,e.obj,p)
  local pendingStatus=require('CSV/Pending').status(now,O.valid(e) and R.classify(e)==e.group,e.expires,e.nextAttempt)
  if pendingStatus=='expired' or pendingStatus=='cancelled' then
   require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('outcome_expired_or_changed',{outcomeKind=e.kind,outcomeGroup=e.group});table.remove(O.pending,i)
  elseif (not s.lastAny or now-s.lastAny>=15000 or R.urgent(e.group)) and pendingStatus=='ready' then
   local f=S.capture(p);f.outcome=e
   local line,policy=V.client.plan(p,V.voice(p),e.group,1,1,f,V.client.preferences())
   local channel=require('CSV/Channel').resolve(policy,require('CSV/Activity').read(p),V.client.preferences())
   if line and channel.allowed and channel.channel~='none' then
    e.nextAttempt=now+3000;S.outcome=S.outcome or setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});S.outcome[p]=e;V.client.lastAttempt[p]=nil
    local ok,err=pcall(require('ConditionalSpeech_Core').generateSpeechFrom,p,e.group,1,1,false,false);S.outcome[p]=nil
    if not ok then error(err)end
    local a=V.client.lastAttempt[p]
    if require('CSV/Pending').accepted(a,e.group) then
     if e.kind=='vehicle_combat' then require('CSV/VehicleCombat').accepted(e) end
     e.consumed=true;s.last[e.group]=now;s.lastAny=now;table.remove(O.pending,i)
     require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('outcome_played',{outcomeKind=e.kind,outcomeGroup=e.group})
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
function O.fuel(p)
 if not eligible(p) then return end
 local car=call(p,'getVehicle');if not car or call(car,'isDriver',p)~=true then return end
 local s=O.players[p] or {last={}};O.players[p]=s
 if s.car~=car then s.car=car;s.lowFuel=false end
 local f=O.snapshot('fuel',car,p)
 if type(f.fuel)=='number' and f.fuel>=20 then s.lowFuel=false end
 if f.running==true and type(f.fuel)=='number' and f.fuel>=0 and f.fuel<15 and not s.lowFuel then
  local e=O.begin('fuel',p,car);e.completed=true;e.after=f
  if O.queue(e,'FuelLow') then s.lowFuel=true end
 end
end
function O.tick()
 local now=V.now();if now<O.nextTick then return end;O.nextTick=now+250
 O.update()
 if now>=(O.nextFuel or 0)then O.nextFuel=now+2000;for i=0,getNumActivePlayers()-1 do O.fuel(getSpecificPlayer(i))end end
end
function O.swing(p,weapon)
 local e=O.begin('swing',p,weapon);O.finish(e)
end
-- The keyboard interaction calls Java directly, bypassing ISOpenCloseDoor.
-- Native failure sound on THIS player's emitter confirms a real failed attempt.
-- Merely facing a locked door, or hearing another player, never qualifies.
function O.nativeDoor(p)
 if not eligible(p) then return end
 local s=O.players[p] or {last={}};O.players[p]=s
 local door=call(p,'getContextDoorOrWindowOrWindowFrame',call(p,'getDir'))
 local prefix=call(door,'getSoundPrefix');local emitter=call(p,'getEmitter')
 local window=call(door,'isPermaLocked')~=nil
 local kind=window and 'window' or 'door'
 local token
 if window and call(door,'IsOpen')==false and call(p,'getVariableBoolean','bOpenWindow')==true and (call(emitter,'isPlaying','WindowIsLocked')==true or call(emitter,'isPlaying','BreakLockOnWindow')==true) then token='locked'

  -- but use the verified killer instead of restoring the nearest-player guess.

 end

  local s=state(p);s.pursuer=attacker;s.pursuerSeen=call(p,'CanSee',attacker)==true

end

end

    elseif group=='Panic' and (f.near or 0)>0 and (f.panic or 0)>0 and f.panic<3 then extraGroup='ThreatTense'

local names={brave='BRAVE',cowardly='COWARDLY',desensitized='DESENSITIZED',agoraphobic='AGORAPHOBIC',claustrophobic='CLAUSTROPHOBIC',hemophobic='HEMOPHOBIC',smoker='SMOKER'}
for key,value in pairs({allThumbs='ALL_THUMBS',clumsy='CLUMSY',conspicuous='CONSPICUOUS',disorganized='DISORGANIZED',hearty='HEARTY_APPETITE',highThirst='HIGH_THIRST',illiterate='ILLITERATE',outOfShape='OUT_OF_SHAPE',illness='PRONE_TO_ILLNESS',feeble='FEEBLE',pacifist='PACIFIST',restless='INSOMNIAC',shortSighted='SHORT_SIGHTED',asthmatic='ASTHMATIC',sleepy='NEEDS_MORE_SLEEP',slowHealer='SLOW_HEALER',slowLearner='SLOW_LEARNER',slowReader='SLOW_READER',sunday='SUNDAY_DRIVER',thinSkin='THIN_SKINNED',unfit='UNFIT',weak='WEAK',weakStomach='WEAK_STOMACH',fastMetabolism='WEIGHT_LOSS',slowMetabolism='WEIGHT_GAIN',lightEater='LIGHT_EATER',deaf='DEAF',hardHearing='HARD_OF_HEARING'})do names[key]=value end

function T.read(player)
 local result={}
 for name,constant in pairs(names)do
  local trait=CharacterTrait and CharacterTrait[constant]
  if trait then local ok,value=pcall(function()return player:hasTrait(trait)end);if ok and type(value)=='boolean' then result[name]=value end end
 end
 return result
end
function T.startle(s)
 local t=s.traits or {}
 -- Actual distress wins over a character-sheet preference. Do not add panic twice.
 if (s.panic or 0)>=3 then return 'StartleCowardly' end
 if t.desensitized then return 'StartleDesensitized' end
 if t.cowardly then return 'StartleCowardly' end
 if t.brave then return 'StartleBrave' end
 return 'StartleNormal'
end
function T.phobiaAllowed(group,s)
 local t=s.traits or {}
 if group=='Agoraphobic' then return t.agoraphobic~=false and s.outside~=false end
 if group=='Claustrophobic' then return t.claustrophobic~=false and s.outside~=true end
 return true
end
function T.context(group,s)
 local selected=require('CSV/TraitSpeechRules').context(group,s)
 if selected then return selected end
 local t=s.traits or {}
 if s.fire or require('CSV/Concealment').active(s) or (s.near or 0)>0 or s.humanThreat then return nil end
 if (group=='Stress' or group=='Panic') and t.hemophobic and (s.bleeding or 0)>0 and (s.panic or 0)>0 then return 'BloodAversion' end
 if group=='Stress' and t.smoker and (s.nicotineStress or 0)>0 then return 'NicotineNeed' end
 if group=='Endurance' and (s.endurance or 0)>=3 and s.sneaking==false and (s.pain or 0)==0 and (s.bleeding or 0)==0 and (s.drunk or 0)==0 and (s.coldSymptoms or 0)==0 then return 'ExhaustedCoping' end
end
function T.startleAllowed(id,s)
 local n=tonumber(id:match('_(%d+)$')) or 0
 if s.sneaking and not require('CSV/Concealment').active(s) then return n<=2 end
 if n>=7 and not require('CSV/Concealment').active(s) then return false end
 if id=='StartleCowardly_8' and (s.panic or 0)<3 then return false end
 return true
end
function T.dryCoping(s)
 local e=s.psychology;local t=s.traits or {}
 return s.recentDistress~=true and e and e.verified and e.kind=='zombieKill' and e.experience=='practiced' and t.desensitized==true
  and s.sneaking==false and s.near==0 and s.visible==0 and s.recentThreat==false and not s.humanThreat and not s.fire
  and s.panic==0 and s.pain==0 and s.bleeding==0 and (s.endurance or 4)<2 and s.drunk==0 and s.coldSymptoms==0
end
return T

local R={groups={},maxSampleAge=500,contactSettle=250,quietGap=6000}
for _,stem in ipairs({'VehicleCrowd','VehicleSiege','VehicleImpact','VehicleKill'})do
 for _,role in ipairs({'Driver','Passenger'})do R.groups[stem..role]='VehicleDamage' end
end
-- Three occupied quadrants alone can still be a crowd on one side. Require
-- at least four threats and no empty angular half-circle around the vehicle.
function R.surrounded(angles)
 if #angles<4 then return false end
 local sorted={};for i,a in ipairs(angles)do sorted[i]=a end;require('CSV/Sort').sort(sorted)
 local gap=sorted[1]+math.pi*2-sorted[#sorted]
 for i=2,#sorted do gap=math.max(gap,sorted[i]-sorted[i-1])end
 return gap<math.pi
end
function R.contact(a,b,now)
 return a and b and a.alive==true and b.contact==true and b.collision==true
  and (a.contact==false or a.trackedContact==true)
  and a.car==b.car and a.driver~=nil and a.driver==b.driver and b.attacker==b.driver
  and a.weaponRevision==b.weaponRevision and a.burning==false and b.burning==false
  and now>=a.at and now-a.at<=R.maxSampleAge
end
function R.classify(e)
 if not e or e.kind~='vehicle_combat' or e.completed~=true or e.cancelled or e.verified~=true then return nil end
 local role=e.role=='driver' and 'Driver' or e.role=='passenger' and 'Passenger'
 if not role or not e.after or e.after.occupied~=true then return nil end
 if e.event=='crowd' or e.event=='siege' then
  if e.surrounded~=true or (e.targets or 0)<4 then return nil end
  if e.event=='siege' and ((e.panic or 0)<3 or (e.attacks or 0)<1) then return nil end
  return (e.event=='siege' and 'VehicleSiege' or 'VehicleCrowd')..role
 end
 if e.aliveBefore~=true or e.nativeContact~=true or e.driverMatched~=true or e.noInterveningHit~=true then return nil end
 if e.event=='impact' then return 'VehicleImpact'..role end
 if e.event=='kill' and e.dead==true and e.observed==true then return 'VehicleKill'..role end
end
return R

local R={groups={EngineRecovered='VehicleDamage',EngineStalled='VehicleDamage',FuelEmpty='VehicleDamage',HotwireDone='VehicleDamage',CarAlarm='VehicleDamage',HeadlightsFailed='VehicleDamage'}}
R.urgent={EngineStalled=true,FuelEmpty=true,CarAlarm=true,HeadlightsFailed=true}
for g,parent in pairs(require('CSV/VehicleCombatRules').groups)do R.groups[g]=parent;R.urgent[g]=true end
function R.classify(e)
 if e and e.kind=='vehicle_combat' then return require('CSV/VehicleCombatRules').classify(e) end
 if not e or e.completed~=true or e.cancelled or e.localAction~=true then return nil end
 local a,b=e.before or {},e.after or {}
 if e.kind=='vehicle_recovered' and e.failedStart==true and a.running==false and b.running==true then return 'EngineRecovered' end
 if e.kind=='vehicle_stop' and a.running==true and b.running==false and e.manual~=true then
  -- A stop alone cannot distinguish the key, a mod, damage or fuel starvation.
  if e.nativeCause=='fuel' and type(a.fuel)=='number' and a.fuel>0 and b.fuel==0 then return 'FuelEmpty' end
  if e.nativeCause=='damage' or e.nativeCause=='fuel' then return 'EngineStalled' end
 end
 if e.kind=='vehicle_hotwire' and a.hotwired==false and b.hotwired==true then return 'HotwireDone' end
 if e.kind=='vehicle_alarm' and e.synchronous==true and a.alarm==false and b.alarm==true then return 'CarAlarm' end
 if e.kind=='vehicle_lights' and a.lights==false and b.lights==true and b.canLight==false and type(b.battery)=='number' and b.battery>0 and b.dark==true then return 'HeadlightsFailed' end
end
return R

local W=require('CSV/Pack').whispers
function W.pick(V,voice,line)
 if not W.approved or not V.extended(voice) or not line then return nil end
 local bank=V.bank and V.bank(voice).whispers or W
 if not bank.approved then return nil end
 local item=bank.catalog[line.id];if item and V.clip(voice,item.id) then return item end
end
function W.contains(id)
 if not W.approved or type(id)~='string' then return false end
 local original=id:match('^Whisper_(.+)$');return original~=nil and W.catalog[original]~=nil
end
return W
